metadata.title: Sun-Drenched Grass Portrait with Lower-Third Sans-Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A high-angle lifestyle shot featuring a subject reclining on textured green grass with a prominent, clean geometric sans-serif title anchored in the bottom right corner.
triggerTerms: reclining on grass with lower right text
minimalist album cover with grass background
excludeWhen: the subject needs to be fully visible
a dark or moody atmosphere is required
serif or decorative typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, sun-lit composition showing a person's legs and torso in a light pink garment resting on a dense lawn, balanced by a large, white, lowercase geometric sans-serif word in the bottom right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject diagonal alignment against horizontal grass texture
High-contrast white typography against dark green grass
Warm skin tones and pink fabric against cool green background
Negative space in the lower right utilized for typographic weight
coreInvariants: High-angle perspective looking down at the grass
Bright, direct sunlight creating sharp shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the upper-left to center-right diagonal, cropped at the torso and feet.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white typography in the bottom right serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the legs from top-left to bottom-right, landing on the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The lower right area of the grass provides the necessary negative space for the text overlay.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural green (grass) providing a textured backdrop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pink (clothing) and warm skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the greens with high value/brightness in the highlights and text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'b' with a perfectly round bowl
Lowercase 'l' as a simple vertical bar
Lowercase 'r' with a short, curved shoulder
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for minimalist impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight spacing.
Classic geometric sans-serif with similar lowercase forms.
Modern geometric feel with clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-angle photograph of a person in a light pink dress reclining on a lush green lawn in bright, direct sunlight. The composition should leave the bottom right quadrant relatively clear of the subject.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in the bottom right corner using a bold, white, lowercase geometric sans-serif font with tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the bottom right corner?
Is the lighting bright and sun-drenched?
Is the font a clean geometric sans-serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is white and solid.
Ensure the subject does not obscure the text.
Verify the high-angle perspective is maintained.
Confirm the lowercase geometric font style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Naturalistic lifestyle photography + Lower-third geometric sans-serif overlay = Modern minimalist aesthetic.
